newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Jan state sector surplus seen at 2 trln lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy Jan state sector surplus seen at 2 trln lire.

text.p: Italy forecast a provisional state sector surplus of two trillion lire at end-January 1997 compared with a public sector borrowing requirement of 12.29 trillion at end-January 1996, the Treasury said in a statement on Monday.
It said one-off items including a new form of payment of tax on production of mineral oils and new rules relating to pensions contributed some 5.0 trillion lire to the state accounts.
It said cash inflows and outflows with the European Union had shown a "favourable trend for us".
